title: Insurance Underwriter
summary: Decides whether an insurer should accept a life, health or general insurance proposal, on what terms and at what premium. Sits in the underwriting team of an insurer, broker or reinsurer and works with sales, medical and claims teams.
dailyDuties: Review proposal forms, medical reports and inspection reports
Accept, load, exclude or decline proposals within authority limits
Rate risks and apply premium loadings
Set policy terms, exclusions and endorsements
Check decisions against IRDAI rules and underwriting guidelines
Track turnaround time in the underwriting MIS

skills.expectation: Assess proposals and decide to accept, accept with terms or decline
Review medical reports and history for life or health proposals
Assess fire, motor, marine, engineering or liability risks for general insurance
Rate risks and apply loadings or discounts within the filed rating structure
Set policy terms, exclusions, deductibles and endorsements
Follow IRDAI rules and the insurer's board-approved underwriting policy
Use claims experience and loss ratios to review renewals and portfolios
Maintain underwriting MIS, turnaround reports and rating sheets in Excel
Explain decisions to sales teams, agents, brokers and customers
Know treaty and facultative reinsurance and retention limits
Check income and sum assured justification for life proposals
Work with sales, claims and medical teams on turnaround targets
